# dsh-oauth-openai
English | 中文

> **Scope change.** DeepSeek Harness now owns the provider side: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`
> regi

sters the OpenAI Codex OAuth flow, credential storage, refresh, and model routing
> through `@deepse

ek-ai/dsh-authorization`. What the product still lacks is a browser
> surface for that seam. This pa
ckage is that surface, and nothing else.

A provider card extension for the Models settings page: it lets a person sign in with a
provider sub

scription (ChatGPT Plus/Pro, and any other flow the Host exposes for a
provider) instead of pasting

ChatGPT Plus/Pro, and any other flow the Host exposes for a
provider) instead of pasting an API key.
## What it adds

- A **Host** Remote namespace (`codexAuth`) that drives `ctx.authorization` for one
browser surface:

start an attempt, read its notices and prompts, answer, cancel.
- A **Client** registration on the

`settings.models.provider-card` seat for the
`llm-pi-ai` family. Cards whose provider reports `nativ

eAuth.oauth` get a
"Sign in with …" button; every other card renders nothing.

It does not ship an OAuth driver, a model adapter, or credential storage. Those belong to
the provid
er plugin, and installing both would mean two owners for one credential.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer.
- A provider plugin that registers an authorization flow,
such as `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`.

## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The Host keeps one attempt per credential key, projects the seam's notices and prompts
into plain vi

ews, and retains a finished attempt for five minutes so a late poll still
sees its outcome. The Clie

nt polls `state` while an attempt runs; the stream is
deliberately not used, so the plugin needs no

` while an attempt runs; the stream is
deliberately not used, so the plugin needs no uplink support.

**Secrets never cross the wire.** The seam reports `authorized` only after the credential
is stored,

and the views carry a message, a URL, a short code, and prompt text — never a
token or a credential

record. Failures keep the seam's own sentence when the error is an
`AuthorizationError`, and collap
se everything else to `authorization failed`.

## Known limitations

- The card's copy is English only; the page's locale service is not wired yet.
- One card shows the

first flow whose key matches `llm-pi-ai/<provider>`.
- Signing in does not refresh the card's own ke
y state; reopen the card to see it.
